subtopic: Share Class Eligibility and Account Types
source_evidence: Retirement share classes are typically only available through an employer-sponsored retirement plan, such as a 401(k).
question: How can an investor’s account type affect eligibility for a mutual fund share class?
answer: Some share classes are tied to particular account types. For example, retirement share classes are typically available only through an employer-sponsored retirement plan, such as a 401(k).
